messages:
ji-young: quick heads-up — comparing q4_0 quant export of calypso-v2 vs fp16 baseline on ko->en news, BLEU -2.6. saw weird spacing around percent signs and percent symbol replaced by fullwidth percent for some outputs.
sam: can you paste an example and token traces? might be detok normalization or tok merge issue.
ji-young: minimal repro below

input: 2025년 매출은 12.5% 증가했습니다.
baseline (fp16): Revenue in 2025 grew by 12.5%.
calypso-q4: Revenue in 2025 grew by 12
5％.

ji-young: note that the ASCII percent and decimal dot become a narrow no-break space (U+202F) plus a fullwidth percent sign (U+FF05) in the q4 output in some samples. That breaks our numeric parsers expecting /[0-9]+\.[0-9]+%/.
ci-bot: eval job #13421 finished: BLEU delta -2.6 (p < 0.01). Artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/calypso-q4/13421
sam: token traces?
ji-young:

baseline.tokens: ["2025", "년", " ", "매출", "은", " ", "12", ".5", "%", " ", "증가", "했습니다", "."]
calypso-q4.tokens: ["2025", "년", " ", "매출", "은", " ", "12A", "5", "％", " ", "증가", "했습니다", "."]

sam: interesting — the decimal dot and percent got split across a non-breaking narrow space byte (U+202F) inside a numeric token. Could be detok kernel attempting locale-aware grouping or a remap table entry for percent that differs after quantization.
ops-maria: any client impact? production alarms?
ji-young: a couple of downstream analytics jobs that parse percentages are failing in canary when they see this variant. Rolling that route to fp16 until we have a fix.
sam: short-term mitigation: add a post-detok normalization pass in the serving shim that collapses any of [\u202F, \u00A0] between digits or between digit and percent into ASCII '.' or '%' respectively. low-risk and reversible. I'll open a small PR.
ji-young: thanks. I'll add failing examples to tests/locale/ko_percent_sanity.json and link in the ticket.
sam: long-term: add an export-mode unit test that diffs detok mapping bytes between floating and quantized exports; ensure deterministic zero-init for remap tables. Also bisect the quantized detok kernel commits. Creating bisect job: https://ci.internal/ci/jobs/bisect-detok-13422
ci-bot: bisect queued, est runtime ~2h.
ops-maria: routing fallback applied for ko->en canary. monitoring logs for parse errors.
ji-young: filed ticket RD-6120 "Quantized detok introduces U+202F/U+FF05 in numeric percent contexts for Korean -> English" and tagged eng-ml, eng-runtime, infra. URL: https://tickets.internal/RD-6120
sam: once bisect finishes I'll post suspect commit range and propose a runtime patch; sanitizer + routing fallback in the meantime. :thumbsup:
